---
title: "Quantum annealing with D-Wave"
---

This module introduces quantum annealing and the D-Wave Ocean software
stack through two computational tutorials.

## Modules

### D-Wave Demonstration

Learn how optimization problems can be represented and solved using
D-Wave's Ocean software tools.

[Start D-Wave Demonstration →](D-wave%20Demonstration.ipynb)

### Additional D-Wave Topics

Explore additional concepts and examples involving quantum annealing
and D-Wave systems.

[Explore Additional D-Wave Topics →](Additional%20D-wave%20Topics.ipynb)

## About

These materials were developed for the Quantum Science, Technology,
and Engineering Workshop at Purdue University.
